name: task-board-default
description: Today's task-board behaviour (skill-project-management origin/main 4b0a75d6) written as a playbook. Reproducing it byte-identically, or with documented differences, is the PC1 acceptance target. Every element cites the code in spec section 14; open points are listed there.

orchestrator.description: Archetype analyst without lifecycle statuses (pkg/board/goal_role.go:25-33); the legacy name coordinator normalizes to it (goal_role.go:10-11).

developer.description: Archetype implementer; start development, end to-review (.roles/developer/role.md).

tester.description: Archetype tester; start development, end to-review (.roles/tester/role.md).

doc-writer.description: Archetype implementer; start development, end to-review (.roles/doc-writer/role.md).

researcher.description: Archetype analyst; start analysis, end to-review (.roles/researcher/role.md).

solution-architect.description: Archetype analyst; start analysis, end to-review.

context-builder.description: Archetype analyst; start analysis, end to-review.

reviewer.description: Archetype reviewer; start reviewing, verdict-driven end (goal_role.go:36-45; .roles/reviewer/role.md).

operator.description: Owns linkless blocked items: external blockers and human-only decisions (pkg/board/blocked_release.go:8-24).

integration.description: The integration production path, the only public exit from integrating to done (pkg/board/consistency.go:169-172).

story.description: Parent must be an epic (types.go:209-218). Status aggregates from children (pkg/board/escalation.go:73).

review.description: Review policy; empty normalizes to required (types.go:106-133).

estimates.name: effort
estimates.description: set_estimate(scale=fibonacci); new records must be estimated before development (pkg/board/validation.go:60-68).

leaf.description: Today's statuses (pkg/board/types.go:23-32). The kernel has no transition table: any non-terminal status may be set when its gates pass, which from * reproduces.

analysis.description: Start status of the analyst roles.

to-dev.description: Queued, nobody owns it; deliberately needs no assignee (validation.go:73-83).

development.description: Start status of implementer and tester roles.

to-review.description: Producer handoff reached; the orchestrator routes a reviewer.

integrating.description: Entered only through accept_cr; left only through integration evidence (consistency.go:166-172).

closed.description: Today closed carries no resolution value.

blocked.description: Linked blocked items release to backlog when every blocker is terminal; linkless ones are stop-the-line and wait for the operator.

transitions.description: Spawned producers must use handoff: checklist complete and <ID>_results.md present (tools/board-cli/cmd/producer_handoff_guard.go:24; pkg/board/handoff.go:122; errors.go:26-44).
Only an accepted immutable revision may enter integration (consistency.go:166-167).
Rejection routes the element to to-dev (tools/board-cli/cmd/change_request.go:753, 825, 856).
Inline done route: refused when a Change Request exists (consistency.go:128-141, 158); commit acknowledgement when the version-control policy confirms (version_control.go:89-123).
A leaf closes from any lifecycle state (validation.go:31-33).
Automatic release of linked blocked items (blocked_release.go:8-24, 87).

container.description: Epics and stories: status aggregates from children (escalation.go:73, 140); only closing and integration set it directly.

transitions.description: A container closes only after every descendant is done or closed (validation.go:34-43).
Story integration; story and bug are the version-control enforced types (version_control.go:277-279).
